newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: RESEARCH ALERT - Comercial del Plata initiated.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Comercial del Plata initiated.

text.p: -- Santander Investment said Thursday it initiated coverage of Argentine holding company Sociedad Comercial del Plata with an underform rating.
-- "Unexciting earnings from the ambitious Tren de la Costa (railway/commercial/entertainment) project, together with high debt, should limit SCP's profitability going forward," Santander said.
-- It forecast net earnings of $35.8 million this year, a year-to-year drop of 1.4 percent.
-- Santander said it expects the Argentine conglomerate to post earnings per share of $0.18, $0.20 and $0.24 for 1997, 1998 and 1999, respectively. In 1996 its earnings were of $0.19 per share.
-- The 12-month target price of $2.73 implies a nine percent rise in the current stock price.

-- "We expect SCP to improve its risk profile as it proceeds with its divestiture and debt-reduction programs...the company will raise roughly $330 million by March 1998, of which $190 million will be used to reduce debt and $140 million will go to finance expenditures."

-- Santander concluded its underperform rating reflected "discouraging returns and heavy debt from its Tren de la Costa project, no new investment projects on the horizon, valuation premiums and a target price nine percent below current levels."
